claudeArgs.title: Claude Code: extra arguments
claudeArgs.description: Added to claude by Launch Claude Code, e.g. --model opus. The program is the claude that was on PATH when its permission was allowed in Settings › Plugins: to use another, put it first on PATH and allow the permission again.

codexArgs.title: Codex: extra arguments
codexArgs.description: Added to codex by Launch Codex, e.g. --model gpt-5. The program is the codex that was on PATH when its permission was allowed in Settings › Plugins.
